Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full plan-comparison payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Compare plans","subtitle":"Pick the plan that fits how you use your phone","currency":"USD","cadence":"mo","currentPlanId":"essential","plans":[{"id":"essential","name":"Essential","price":45,"tagline":"For light users","features":["10 GB premium data","5G nationwide","SD streaming"]},{"id":"unlimited","name":"Unlimited Plus","price":70,"tagline":"Our most popular plan","badge":"Most popular","recommended":true,"features":["Unlimited premium data","HD streaming","50 GB hotspot","5G Ultra Capacity"]},{"id":"premium","name":"Premium 5G","price":90,"tagline":"Everything, maxed out","features":["Unlimited premium data","4K UHD streaming","100 GB hotspot","Global roaming"]}],"submitText":"Switch plan"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Compare plans'.
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short line under the title.
- 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code (e.g. 'USD','EUR','GBP') applied to every plan without its own 'currency'. Defaults to 'USD'.
- 'cadence' (string, optional): billing period suffix shown next to price; one of 'mo' (per month), 'yr' (per year), 'wk' (per week). Defaults to 'mo'.
- 'currentPlanId' (string, optional): the 'id' of the plan the customer is already on. That plan is marked 'Current plan' and cannot be selected.
- 'plans' (array, REQUIRED, 2 to 4 objects): the plans to compare, shown top to bottom in the order given. Each plan MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back when the customer picks it), 'name' (string), and 'price' (number). Optional per plan: 'tagline' (string, one short line under the name); 'currency' (string, overrides the payload currency); 'badge' (string, short corner tag e.g. 'Most popular','Best value','New' — ignored on the current plan); 'recommended' (boolean; highlights the plan with an accent border — set true on at most one plan, and not on the current plan); 'features' (array of short strings shown as a check-marked list — keep each under ~40 characters and list 2 to 5 per plan).
- 'submitText' (string, optional): confirm-button label; defaults to 'Switch plan'.

Never emit fewer than two plans or more than four. Do not mark the customer's current plan as 'recommended'. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
